Lean spike on source dbc6955a9b1fe9de92acc167301342915916f307 is committed locally on spike/microcfta-lean-soundness: b6a9902 proofs, 5f85b4e report/repros. No push. lean/README.md maps coverage and explicit gaps. Lean 4.34.1 clean build passes; 162 source theorems, 412 theorem declarations including generated equations pass a transitive axiom allowlist (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). Deliberate sorry probe fails audit. General proofs cover exact bounded enumeration and recursive finite-term completeness, synchronous intersection, immediate-child equality sharing, weighted finite probability laws, guard-split/pruning obligations, selected lattice identities, and acceptance iff positive probability at some bound for a uniform-run reference sampler. This is not whole-Haskell verification: interning, UVar engine, observation tries, recursive size tables, full lattice elimination/ranking, SMT/RNG remain outside proof.
Three current defects reproduce in lean/repro/Counterexamples.hs: (1) NEW: f[A={a},B={b}] guarded Not(Same [0] [1]), same leaf refinement class via standard refinementSubtypingOn, starts with f(a,b). Both minimize and reduce return empty denotation after redirecting to f[A,A]. Structural productivity ignores guards. Lean proves no accepted term remains at any depth. Repair needs context/guard-compatible replacement, not type subtyping alone. (2) Repeated-path Holds self-equality still returns No and compiles EmptyGenerator because occurrence formals are independent. (3) groupBuilt now preserves outcome masses, but observed atomic choice leaf a vs wrap b changes sizes [1,1] to [1,2]; upToSize 1 loses value 1 and exact PMF changes [(0,1/2),(1,1/2)] to [(0,1)]. Existing 566 core/generator/refinement examples all pass. Production fixes are not included.

Continuation after pulling ae6b97b8a8fc9282999c031671b743f8983786a3: all three original fixtures now pass (Holds Yes/Right1; atomic sizes/PMF preserved; disequal f(a,b) retained by minimize and reduce). Added 98 Lean theorems, 260 total source theorems; clean build and axiom audit pass for 708 declarations including generated theorems. New modules: Holds proves actual first-name insertion/emitted aliases sound and complete for both polarities; Decoder proves compositional count, exact rank decoding, map/choice normalization, fused application fast paths, and height-bounded plain-graph compilation; Minimization proves the new polarity-sensitive guard classification under explicit compatibility conditions; Sized proves top-level atomic repair and concrete finite grouping, plus a proposed general size-retention design. Whole Haskell correspondence, graph read traversal, SMT, caches, machine Int, and complete recursive/lattice counting remain outside proof. Commits 6bffebd and acfe8bf are LOCAL, unpushed. Report: lean/CONTINUATION.md.
Two remaining defects at ae6b97b are reproducible in lean/repro/RemainingFindings.hs. (1) Non-atomic Built source via ungroup . keyed () loses source-choice sizes when observed: leaf a versus wrap(b), sizes [1,1] -> [1,2], bound1 PMF [(0,1/2),(1,1/2)] -> [(0,1)]. A built product with a nested atomic child changes [2,2] -> [3,4]; bound2 becomes EmptyGenerator. Retain each member's original size, not only staticAtomic. (2) A representative can be structurally productive but semantically empty due to its own guard. Standard refinementSubtypingOn with a:v>=0 strictly below b:true forces selection independently of interning order. Direct minimize loses f(b); a compound Substitute guard with unknown sparse identity survives prune, so reduce ALSO changes {f(b)} -> {}. Prune kept the original graph in the executable repro. The simple false leaf is pruned correctly, so use the compound case to test reduce. Need semantic nonemptiness/accepted witness of chosen representatives as well as context guard compatibility.
Existing suites pass: 261 core + 182 generator + 128 refinement = 571 examples, zero failures. No production Haskell edits.

Continuation audited at adb1f012b336ba0d1673f8fd7f310ad75bdfaf04. Rebased existing Lean spike cleanly; prior patches unchanged. All earlier alias, source-size, guard-read, and rejected-representative reproductions now pass. Added finite productivity/closure, per-size mass formulas, concrete sparse convolution, zero-size split and integer-closure proofs. Clean Lean 4.34.1 build: 374 named theorems; 970 theorem declarations pass axiom audit. Existing Haskell suites: 263 + 182 + 136 = 581 examples, zero failures.
Two new public defects: (1) a tautological observation of an atomic 9:1 child in a pair preserves sizes [2,2] and unbounded mass, but changes upToSize 2 PMF from 9:1 to 1:1; groupBuilt omits per-size masses for atomic buckets and pair merge falls back to counts. (2) minimization can remove initial leaf b in favor of accepted descendant a; a rejecting surviving root remains structurally productive, so both minimize and reduce can lose all terms when pruning retains a substitution guard. Lean proves the resulting root rejects all finite terms. Separately, exposed internal productIndex with a size-zero operand hides counts behind its (1,0) prefix and incorrectly clears isUnguarded; public compiler reachability is unconfirmed.
Current report: lean/SECOND-REPAIRS.md. Reproduction: lean/repro/CurrentFindings.hs. Proofs and findings committed locally as 2a12039 and 193322a; not pushed. Complete Haskell correspondence, minimization scheduling, lazy recursive tables and lattice elimination remain unproved.
